events.title: Unmanned Systems, U.S. Drone Investment, and Lessons from Ukraine
events.description: CSIS virtual event on lessons from Ukraine on unmanned systems and U.S. drone supply chains and investment.
events.why: Drone supply chains and defense-tech investment are core emerging-tech security topics.

events.title: CSIS-DAPA 2026: Transforming the U.S.-ROK Defense Industrial Partnership for the Future
events.location: CSIS, 1616 Rhode Island Ave NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Center for the Industrial Base keynote and public panel on U.S.-Korea defense industrial cooperation and coproduction (livestreamed).
events.why: Allied defense-industrial coproduction with Korea touches tech supply chains and industrial policy.

events.title: Taiwan and the Pacific
events.location: CSIS, 1616 Rhode Island Ave NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Freeman Chair conversation on the U.S.-Taiwan-Australia partnership, cross-Strait deterrence and Taiwan's regional role.
events.why: Mostly security diplomacy, little technology content.

events.title: Commanding the Autonomous Battlefield
events.description: Bryan Clark and Anduril SVP for Technology Gokul Subramanian on the future of military command-and-control concepts and technologies.
events.why: Autonomy and AI-enabled command and control is squarely emerging tech and security.

events.title: The Dynamics and Implications of US Tariff Policy
events.location: Hudson Institute, 1201 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC
events.description: Discussion on the evolving dynamics of US trade and investment policies.
events.why: Kilcrease and Walters cover economic security and tech trade; relevant tariff and investment-screening context.

events.title: How can we protect consumers from AI-enabled fraud, scams, and other abuses?
events.description: Online Brookings event on consumer protection against AI-enabled fraud, scams and other abuses.
events.why: AI governance and consumer-protection policy, directly on ETI's AI policy track.
